t: The Forge Energy Power Tap allows you to extract energy from a Turbine.$(br2)Like its name implies, this Power Tap outputs energy using the Forge Energy $(l:bigreactors:misc/powersystem)power system$(/l) and so it can be connected only to pipes or machines compatible with that system.
Forge Energy 能量输出端口允许你从涡轮机中提取能量。$(br2)顾名思义，这个能量输出端口使用 Forge Energy $(l:bigreactors:misc/powersystem)供能系统$(/l)输出能量，因此它只能连接到兼容该系统的管道或机器。

Only one $(l:bigreactors:misc/powersystem)power system$(/l) can be used for each Turbine and so only one type of Power Tap can be used to build a single Turbine.$(br2)The Power Tap is available in both $(l:bigreactors:misc/passiveactiveparts)passive and active$(/l) form.
每台涡轮机只能使用一种$(l:bigreactors:misc/powersystem)供能系统$(/l)，因此在建造单台涡轮机时也只能使用一种类型的能量输出端口。$(br2)能量输出端口同时提供$(l:bigreactors:misc/passiveactiveparts)被动和主动$(/l)两种形式。
$(l)Mandatory:$() no$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Variants:$() all$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no$(br)$(l)Power system:$() Forge Energy
